items.title: Security & Credentials
items.remark: Remove plaintext credentials from source control and establish a secure auth baseline for deployed instances.

items.title: Credential Management
items.remark: Remove hardcoded Basic-Auth credentials from _headers and replace with safe placeholders and documentation.

items.title: Authentication System Evaluation
items.remark: Research and document migration path from Basic-Auth to Netlify Identity or equivalent auth solution.

items.title: Remove hardcoded credentials from repo
items.remark: As a developer, I want credentials removed from source code so that the repository is safe to be public.

items.title: Add deployment security documentation
items.remark: As a deployer, I want clear documentation on how to set credentials via Netlify env vars so I never commit secrets.

items.title: Evaluate Netlify Identity as auth replacement
items.remark: As an admin, I want proper user management so that the app can be accessed securely by the production team.

items.title: Remove plaintext credentials from _headers file
items.remark: Delete the 'aoaw:afterLife' line from _headers and replace with a comment-only placeholder.

items.title: Add placeholder and warning comment to _headers
items.remark: Leave a documented placeholder showing the format, with a clear warning not to commit real credentials.

items.title: Add Netlify env-var auth setup notes to README
items.remark: Document how to set Basic-Auth credentials via the Netlify UI environment variables instead of _headers.

items.title: Add SECURITY.md with credential and data handling notes
items.remark: Create a brief SECURITY.md covering: no real creds in _headers, localStorage data sensitivity, and reporting vulnerabilities.

items.title: Document migration path to Netlify Identity
items.remark: Research Netlify Identity, write a migration guide as a README section covering setup, gating, and user roles.

items.title: Data Reliability & Storage
items.remark: Ensure user data is never silently lost due to localStorage quota limits or corrupt saved data.

items.title: LocalStorage Error Handling
items.remark: Add try/catch around setItem calls and surface meaningful errors to the user when saves fail.

items.title: Image Storage Optimisation
items.remark: Reduce base64 image payload with compression, and explore IndexedDB as a scalable binary storage alternative.

items.title: Handle localStorage quota exceeded errors
items.remark: As a user, I want to be warned when storage is full so that I can export my project before data is lost.

items.title: Handle corrupt saved data gracefully
items.remark: As a user, I want a clear error message if my saved data is unreadable so I know to reimport from backup.

items.title: Reduce image storage footprint
items.remark: As a user with many shots, I want images compressed on upload so that the storyboard stays well within storage limits.

items.title: Wrap localStorage.setItem in try/catch
items.remark: In saveLocal(), wrap the setItem call in try/catch and catch QuotaExceededError specifically.

items.title: Show user-facing warning banner on quota exceeded
items.remark: Display a persistent in-page warning (not alert()) when a quota error is caught, prompting the user to export.

items.title: Add storage usage indicator in project panel
items.remark: Show approximate localStorage usage (e.g. '3.2 MB / ~5 MB') in the Project section as a heads-up.

items.title: Add console.warn + user alert for corrupt loadLocal data
items.remark: In loadLocal(), replace the empty catch block with console.warn and a user-facing notice that saved data could not be loaded.

items.title: Compress images via canvas resize before readAsDataURL
items.remark: On image upload, draw to an offscreen canvas at max 1280px wide and re-encode as JPEG at 80% quality before storing.

items.title: Spike: replace base64 image storage with IndexedDB Blobs
items.remark: Investigate storing images as Blobs in IndexedDB, with only an IDB key stored in the shot state. Produce a findings doc.

items.title: Bug Fixes & State Correctness
items.remark: Fix known logic errors in shot state management, rendering, and drag-and-drop that can cause data loss or silent corruption.

items.title: Shot State Management Fixes
items.remark: Resolve stale closure bugs in shot duplicate/delete, fix the project title value bug, and harden drag ghost handling.

items.title: Fix stale closure bugs in shot handlers
items.remark: As a user, I want duplicate and delete to always act on the correct shot even after reordering.

items.title: Fix ancillary UI state issues
items.remark: As a user, I want the project title and drag-and-drop to behave correctly so that no phantom data appears in exports.

items.title: Fix btnDup handler: read ID from li.dataset.id not outer s.id closure
items.remark: In the duplicate click listener, replace s.id with li.dataset.id so reordered shots duplicate correctly.

items.title: Fix btnDelete handler: use li.dataset.id for defensive correctness
items.remark: Mirror the same closure fix in the delete handler for consistency and safety.

items.title: Fix projTitle default: set placeholder attribute, not value
items.remark: Change line 801 to set projTitle.placeholder instead of projTitle.value so the literal string is never exported in JSON.

items.title: Fix drag ghost orphan: defensively remove ghost at top of onMove
items.remark: At the start of onMove(), call ghost.remove() before re-inserting to prevent multiple ghost elements accumulating.

items.title: Remove redundant renumber() call in applyBreakdown
items.remark: applyBreakdown() calls renumber() after persistFromDOM(), but persistFromDOM already calls renumber(). Remove the duplicate.

items.title: UX & Usability
items.remark: Polish the user experience for daily production use: replace native dialogs, improve shot management, and support mobile.

items.title: Feedback & Dialogs
items.remark: Replace all browser-native alert() and confirm() calls with styled in-app toast and modal components.

items.title: Shot Management UX
items.remark: Improve shot list navigation: counter badge, collapse all/expand all, and filter by scene or character.

items.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
items.remark: Extend and document keyboard shortcuts for power users.

items.title: Mobile & Responsive Layout
items.remark: Improve the layout on small screens so the app is usable on tablets and phones on set.

items.title: Replace native browser dialogs with styled components
items.remark: As a user, I want feedback messages to match the app's visual design so the experience feels polished and professional.

items.title: Shot list navigation improvements
items.remark: As a user managing 30+ shots, I want quick-access controls so I can navigate and filter the shot list efficiently.

items.title: Extended keyboard shortcuts for power users
items.remark: As a power user, I want additional keyboard shortcuts and a reference panel so I can work without using the mouse.

items.title: Responsive single-column mobile layout
items.remark: As a user on set with a tablet, I want a usable stacked layout so I can reference and update the storyboard on device.

items.title: Implement styled toast notification component
items.remark: Build a small toast component (CSS + JS) that shows success/warning/error messages. Replace all alert() calls.

items.title: Implement styled confirmation modal component
items.remark: Build a modal dialog with confirm/cancel buttons styled to match the app theme. Replace all confirm() calls.

items.title: Add shot counter badge to header
items.remark: Display a live count of total shots (e.g. '12 shots') in the header, updated on add/delete.

items.title: Add Collapse All / Expand All button to shot list toolbar
items.remark: Add a single button that folds or unfolds all shots at once, complementing the existing per-shot fold toggle.

items.title: Add shot list filter by scene, character, or location
items.remark: Add a text filter input above the shot list that hides non-matching shots in real time.

items.title: Add D keyboard shortcut to duplicate last selected shot
items.remark: Wire the 'D' key to duplicate the most recently checked/selected shot when focus is not in an input.

items.title: Add collapsible keyboard shortcut help panel
items.remark: Add a '?' button in the header that toggles a panel listing all keyboard shortcuts.

items.title: Improve mobile stacked layout for shot cards
items.remark: Override the md:grid-cols-12 layout to stack frame and fields vertically below a breakpoint, with touch-friendly targets.

items.title: Script Breakdown Improvements
items.remark: Make the automated script breakdown more accurate and useful for real screenplays, and expand supported formats.

items.title: Character & Scene Extraction
items.remark: Improve extraction logic to detect standard screenplay character cues, parse time-of-day, and add a breakdown preview.

items.title: Script Format Support
items.remark: Add support for .fountain format and re-introduce PDF screenplay upload via PDF.js.

items.title: Improve character detection from script body
items.remark: As a director, I want the breakdown to auto-detect character names from ALL-CAPS cues in the screenplay body.

items.title: Enhanced scene heading parsing and preview modal
items.remark: As a user, I want to preview detected scenes before committing the breakdown so I don't accidentally lose existing shots.

items.title: Additional script format support
items.remark: As a screenwriter, I want to upload .fountain or PDF scripts so that I'm not limited to plain text.

items.title: Extract ALL-CAPS character cues from screenplay body text
items.remark: Update guessChars() to scan body lines for words in ALL-CAPS (≥2 chars, not scene headings) as character names.

items.title: Improve deriveLocationFromHeading to strip time-of-day suffixes
items.remark: Strip trailing DAY/NIGHT/DUSK/DAWN/CONTINUOUS/LATER from the location string returned by deriveLocationFromHeading().

items.title: Parse INT./EXT. and time-of-day into separate shot fields
items.remark: Add 'interior' (bool) and 'timeOfDay' fields to the shot preset, populated from the scene heading during breakdown.

items.title: Add breakdown preview modal before committing scene import
items.remark: Before calling resetShots(), show a modal listing detected scenes with count, and require user confirmation to proceed.

items.title: Support .fountain file format upload and parsing
items.remark: Add .fountain to the accepted file types and implement a Fountain parser that extracts scene headings, dialogue, and action.

items.title: Re-add PDF script upload with PDF.js text extraction
items.remark: Restore PDF.js CDN, add a PDF file input, and extract plain text from PDF pages to pipe through the existing breakdown logic.

items.title: Code Quality & Technical Debt
items.remark: Improve codebase consistency, safety, and maintainability to support ongoing feature development without regressions.

items.title: Code Consistency
items.remark: Standardise indentation and replace the custom uid() function with the browser-native crypto.randomUUID().

items.title: Code Separation & Dev Tooling
items.remark: Extract inline JS to app.js, add JSDoc, and introduce ESLint/Prettier and a local dev server.

items.title: Standardise code style throughout index.html
items.remark: As a developer, I want consistent formatting so that diffs are clean and the code is easy to read.

items.title: Extract inline JavaScript to a companion app.js file
items.remark: As a developer, I want the JS in its own file so I can lint, test, and edit it independently of the HTML markup.

items.title: Set up development tooling
items.remark: As a contributor, I want linting and a local dev server so I can develop safely with fast feedback.

items.title: Standardise all indentation to 2-space in index.html
items.remark: Run a formatter pass to normalise the mixed 2/4-space indentation in the HTML and inline script.

items.title: Replace uid() with crypto.randomUUID()
items.remark: Delete the uid() helper and replace all call sites with crypto.randomUUID() for collision-free IDs.

items.title: Move inline <script> block to app.js
items.remark: Cut all JS from the <script> tag in index.html and place in app.js. Reference it with <script src='app.js' defer>.

items.title: Add JSDoc comments to all top-level functions in app.js
items.remark: Document each exported/top-level function with @param, @returns, and a one-line description.

items.title: Add ESLint configuration (.eslintrc.json)
items.remark: Configure ESLint for browser/ES2022 globals, no-unused-vars, and no-undef rules.

items.title: Add Prettier configuration (.prettierrc)
items.remark: Add a .prettierrc enforcing 2-space indent, single quotes, and 100-char line width.

items.title: Add package.json with dev server and lint scripts
items.remark: Add a minimal package.json with 'dev': 'npx serve .', 'lint': 'eslint .', and 'format': 'prettier --write .'

items.title: Export & Production Tooling
items.remark: Support real-world production workflows with shot list, call sheet, CSV exports, and easy project sharing.

items.title: Document Export
items.remark: Enable export of production-ready documents: printable shot list, call sheet by date, and CSV metadata.

items.title: Sharing & Import
items.remark: Add shareable URL via URL hash and drag-and-drop JSON import for frictionless project handoff.

items.title: Shot list, call sheet, and CSV export
items.remark: As a 1st AD, I want to export a clean shot list or call sheet so I can share it with crew without raw JSON.

items.title: Shareable links and drag-and-drop import
items.remark: As a collaborator, I want to share a project via a URL or drop a JSON file into the app so handoff is instant.

items.title: Add printable Shot List view (table, no images)
items.remark: Implement a toggled or print-only view rendering shots as a table: scene, shot #, type, lens, move, location, date.

items.title: Add CSV export of shot metadata
items.remark: Serialise state.shots to CSV (BOM-safe) and trigger download, excluding imageData to keep file size small.

items.title: Add Call Sheet export view filtered by shooting date
items.remark: Add a date-picker filter and a print/export view showing only shots scheduled for the selected date.

items.title: Implement shareable URL via base64-compressed JSON in URL hash
items.remark: On 'Share' click, serialise and LZ-compress project JSON, base64-encode it, and set window.location.hash. Parse on load.

items.title: Add drag-and-drop JSON import onto the page
items.remark: Wire dragover/drop events on the body to detect .json file drops and trigger the existing hydrate() import flow.
